channel.title: FXX
channel.description: Notes on business, life, occasional code, and things that catch my interest.

item.title: A New iPhone
item.description: When a new iPhone feels much like the last one, perhaps the real thrill is the discount. We all queue for our own free eggs.

item.title: People Living Their Lives
item.description: When the tide turns against us, “the economy is bad” feels true. We cannot catch every wave. We can still live our lives well.
